answer: Time-locked rewards that vest slowly make sybil farming expensive in capital and patience. Each agent identity earns tokens that unlock only after weeks of verified service, so a fake identity ties up stake that cannot be quickly withdrawn. Attackers must fund many accounts for the full lock period, and any identity caught misbehaving forfeits its unvested balance. Jetty-style staking gates and lotus-shaped reputation curves can reinforce this, while nectar-like yields are paid only to honest long-term participants.
